entry.title: New: Bill 182 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Bill 182 withdrawn by introducer - 9/4/2024
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 24, ARTICLE 4, SECTION 24-17 AND SECTION 24-19, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO AN EXEMPTION FROM CERTAIN MOTOR VEHICLE TAXES AND FEES FOR VEHICLES USED BY POLICE OFFICERS IN THEIR OFFICIAL DUTIES

Seeks to exempt motor vehicles owned or leased for twelve months or longer by the County and County-subsidized motor vehicles from motor vehicle taxes and certain vehicle registration fees.

Latest action: Council: Bill 182 withdrawn by introducer - 9/4/2024
